note: Crowd appearance pool (appearance only, no stat change). The existing human looks stay and rotate with the new bodies: the rows 'hollow-scavenger' and 'hale-pitborn' are native (the existing rig and clips) and carry most of the weight, so at least half of the plain residents keep an existing look in every area (a test pins it). A plain resident human (rig hollow-scavenger, a registered placement key, no boss profile, no marked hunter, no appearanceRef, no gaunt or crooked recipe) is dressed from this list: first each area draws up to maxBodiesPerArea downloadable rows from the active rows (weighted, seeded by area and ref; the default scavenger look always takes part and downloads nothing), then each resident draws one row from that area's set (weighted, seeded by area and placement key). The same area and key always give the same look. A model is only downloaded, best effort and never required, when an area with a resident that draws it is entered; a resident whose file has not arrived keeps the scavenger look. Only bodies checked clean at close-up are registered (no circular logo-like print). Final pick: set active true or false and change weights here; every ref must be a model row in assets/manifest-hollow.json. enabled false or ?nocrowd=1 gives the plain scavenger back everywhere.
